∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) {ι : Type u_3} (X : ι → Type u_4) (V : Type u_5) (U : Type u_6) [inst : Field.{u_1} k]
  [inst_1 : IsAlgClosed.{u_1} k] [inst_2 : Ring.{u_2} A] [inst_3 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A] [inst_4 : Fintype.{u_3} ι]
  [inst_5 : DecidableEq.{u_3 + 1} ι] [inst_6 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup.{u_4} (X i)]
  [inst_7 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_1, u_4} k (X i)] [inst_8 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_2, u_4} A (X i)]
  [inst_9 : ∀ (i : ι), IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_4} k A (X i)] [inst_10 : ∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_2, u_4} A (X i)]
  [inst_11 : ∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_4} k (X i)] [inst_12 : AddCommGroup.{u_5} V]
  [inst_13 : Module.{u_1, u_5} k V] [inst_14 : Module.{u_2, u_5} A V] [inst_15 : IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_5} k A V]
  [inst_16 : AddCommGroup.{u_6} U] [inst_17 : Module.{u_1, u_6} k U] [inst_18 : Module.{u_2, u_6} A U]
  [inst_19 : IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_6} k A U]
  (hpair :
    ∀ (i j : ι),
      Ne.{u_3 + 1} i j → IsEmpty.{u_4 + 1} (LinearEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_4, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A) (X i) (X j)))
  [inst_20 : FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_5} k V] [inst_21 : IsSemisimpleModule.{u_2, u_5} A V]
  [inst_22 : FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_6} k U] [inst_23 : IsSemisimpleModule.{u_2, u_6} A U]
  (hcV :
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{u_2, u_5} A V),
      IsSimpleModule.{u_2, u_5} A (Subtype.{u_5 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_5, u_5} W x) →
        Exists.{u_3 + 1} fun i =>
          Nonempty.{max (u_4 + 1) (u_5 + 1)}
            (LinearEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_5, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A)
              (Subtype.{u_5 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_5, u_5} W x) (X i)))
  (hcU :
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{u_2, u_6} A U),
      IsSimpleModule.{u_2, u_6} A (Subtype.{u_6 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_6, u_6} W x) →
        Exists.{u_3 + 1} fun i =>
          Nonempty.{max (u_4 + 1) (u_6 + 1)}
            (LinearEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_6, u_4} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A)
              (Subtype.{u_6 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_6, u_6} W x) (X i)))
  (f : LinearMap.{u_2, u_2, u_5, u_6} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A) V U),
  Eq.{max (u_5 + 1) (u_6 + 1)} (LinearMap.restrictScalars.{u_1, u_2, u_5, u_6} k f)
    (LinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_5, max (max u_3 u_4) u_6, u_6}
      (LinearEquiv.toLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, max (max u_3 u_4) u_6, u_6}
        (Etingof.evalDirectSumEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_6} k A X U hpair hcU))
      (LinearMap.comp.{u_1, u_1, u_1, u_5, max (max u_4 u_5) u_3, max (max u_3 u_4) u_6}
        (DirectSum.lmap.{u_1, u_3, max u_4 u_5, max u_4 u_6} fun i =>
          LinearMap.rTensor.{u_1, u_4, max u_4 u_5, max u_4 u_6} (X i)
            (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1)) (u_5 + 1)) (u_6 + 1), max (u_5 + 1) (u_6 + 1),
                max (max (max (u_3 + 1) (u_4 + 1)) (u_5 + 1)) (u_6 + 1)}
              (Etingof.postcompHom.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5, u_6} k A X V U) f i))
        (LinearEquiv.toLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_5, max (max u_3 u_4) u_5}
          (LinearEquiv.symm.{u_1, u_1, max (max u_3 u_4) u_5, u_5}
            (Etingof.evalDirectSumEquiv.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5} k A X V hpair hcV)))))
